# Doomore

> Doomore is a free, open-source, local-only macOS menu bar app (Swift, SwiftUI, Apple Vision) that guesses when you have looked away from your work, such as checking your phone, and sends a gentle or full-screen reminder to get back to work. It runs entirely on the Mac, saves no camera frames, and sends nothing over the network. Status: experimental. License: MIT.

## Key facts

- Platform: macOS 14 or later, Apple silicon. Tested so far on macOS 27.
- Signals: head position, hands in view, keyboard and mouse idle time, front app, and whether a call or video is playing. It does not directly detect a phone. The microphone is never used while monitoring.
- Intensities: Gentle, Standard, Strict.
- Dismissal: wait 15 seconds, solve a math problem, type a commitment, or stand up and stretch.
- Learning: "Not a distraction" makes detection less sensitive after repeated use.
- Distribution: GitHub releases, ad-hoc signed, not notarized.
